purpose: Range-bound the Type-0x07 moving-interaction stream and both direct Type-0x58 interaction animation roots.

movement.name: ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE07_MOVING_INTERACTION
movement.behavior: Zero-delta timer setup followed by repeated (+1, 0) steps, flag clear, timer reload, and local loop through 0x001216CE.

animations.name: ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE07_MOVING_INTERACTION
animations.behavior: 0x1A46-0x1A5A frame presentation with actor-flip command, player-X distance 0x55 branch to the embedded alternate sequence, and loops through 0x001252F4.

animations.name: ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE58_INTERACTION_ALTERNATE
animations.behavior: Alternate post-allocation presentation that publishes actor type 0x84 and loops through the 0x1582-0x1592 response sequence.

animations.name: ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE58_INTERACTION
animations.behavior: Primary presentation that publishes type 0x84, applies the encoded interaction gate and actor-field write, republishes type 0x58, and loops through 0x0012539A.

boundaries.reason: The alternate Type-0x58 root ends at 0x0012538F; the primary root begins at 0x00125392.
The primary Type-0x58 root ends at 0x001253E7; the separately referenced 0x001253E8 stream is not included.
